notes: Sourced from BrightSign's own official docs (manufacturer): overview/interfaces list at docs.brightsign.biz/hardware/xd234-xd1034 and detailed electrical spec at docs.brightsign.biz/hardware/xdx34-hardware-interfaces. HDMI grade (2.0) and Ethernet grade (1000BASE-T = eth-1g) are explicitly stated; USB grade (2.0, 480 Mbit/s) explicitly stated for both ports. Two ports (3.5mm IR in/out, 3.5mm serial) are physically 3.5mm TRS mini-jacks repurposed for non-audio signals — mapped to the logical connector ids "ir" and "rs232" respectively rather than "trs-3.5" since that better reflects signal compatibility; flagged per-port. GPIO is a 12-pin pluggable header, mapped to "euroblock" as closest available id. Power connector is a locking 2-pin DC connector, mapped to "dc-barrel" as closest available id (not a literal coaxial barrel jack). Omitted from the port list (not physical cable I/O in the AV signal/power sense): microSD card slot, status LEDs, SVC/Reset buttons, and two WiFi antenna connectors (RP-SMA-style, for optional WiFi/BT antennas — no connector id in the allowed list fits an RF antenna jack). Desktop/embedded form factor — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Device is the "Expanded I/O" variant of the Series 4 XDx34 line (sibling model XD234 lacks the USB and serial ports); this record is XD1034-specific.

ports.name: USB 2.0 (Type A)
ports.note: Host port; DCP charging capable, up to 1.5A; 480 Mbit/s max

ports.name: USB 2.0 (Type C)
ports.note: Dual-role (host or device) port, up to 1A; 480 Mbit/s max

ports.name: 3.5mm Audio Out
ports.note: Combo analog (2V RMS)/TOSLINK optical output via 3.5mm jack; analog and digital cannot be used simultaneously

ports.name: 3.5mm IR In/Out
ports.note: Physically a 3.5mm TRS mini-jack (tip=3.3V, ring=IR in, sleeve=IR out); NEC/Pronto Hex space-encoded IR

ports.name: 3.5mm Serial
ports.note: Physically a 3.5mm TRS mini-jack carrying RS-232 levels (not DE9); TX/RX/GND only, no RTS/CTS; default 115200 8N1; player is DCE

ports.name: GPIO
ports.note: 12-pin pluggable terminal-block header (Phoenix Contact/Würth style, not a screw-clamp Euroblock); switch/LED/contact-closure control, 3.3V logic, 24mA max per line

ports.name: Power Connector
ports.note: 12V@3A; physically a right-side-positive, locking 2-pin (1x2) Molex-style DC connector, not a coaxial barrel jack
